sections.verified:
- The same Section 3.5 math-heavy QTI now supports two proof modes:
  - Choices embedded inside the prompt image with Google controls as `A/B/C/D`.
  - Question image only with formatted Google Forms choice text.
- The second route converts common MathML to readable Unicode/plain math text for controls:
  - `x² + 12`
  - `x² + 12x + 8`
  - `2x + 8`
  - `x² + 8x + 12`
- The short-answer image-only route still looks clean.
- The live Google Forms bridge accepted the rendered prompt images and choice-text controls.
sections.weakProvisional:
- This remains a proof script, not a polished batch cartridge converter.
- The MathML-to-text converter covers common structures currently needed here: `mfenced`, `mrow`, `mstyle`, `mi`, `mn`, `mo`, `msup`, `msub`, and `mfrac`.
- More complex MathML may need additional formatting rules.
- The proof script and test are untracked and not committed.
sections.unverified:
- User-side visual inspection of the second live Google Form.
- Full-course batch conversion across all 78 QTI assessments.
- Every item type and every math/image combination in the cartridge.
sections.risks:
- Google Forms choice text cannot be true rendered MathML; this route is best-effort Unicode/text math.
- Some equations may be too complex for readable choice text and should fall back to `--include-choices-in-image`.
- If this becomes the main route, it should be promoted from proof script to a documented batch command with a per-question fallback mode.
